list.title: Workload bindings
list.subtitle: Map an AWS, GitHub Actions, HCP Terraform, or Kubernetes workload token to a service principal. Assign roles to the principal like any other.
list.emptyHint: Add a binding so a service can exchange its platform's OIDC token for a short-lived credential.
list.noIssuers: No workload issuers are configured. Set PM_CI_OIDC_ISSUERS on the control plane first.
list.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Every token it minted is revoked.

form.addDescription: A token from the issuer whose subject and every condition match is exchanged for a credential of this principal.
form.editDescription: Narrowing the match, the principal, purposes, or scopes revokes every token this binding minted.
form.subjectHint: The token's exact sub, or a prefix ending in *.
form.conditionsHint: One claim per line as claim=value; separate several accepted values with commas. A value ending in * is a prefix.
form.principalHint: Defaults to svc:<name>. Give it roles under Policies → Assignments.
form.purposeWire: Wire: a SQL connection token for goproxy
form.purposeMcp: MCP: an access token for the MCP endpoint
form.scopesHint: The most an MCP exchange may carry. Cedar still decides every call.
form.enabledHint: Disabling revokes every token this binding minted.
form.invalidConditions: Each condition line needs a claim, an equals sign, and a value.
